Subject: SF Executive Dinner & Roundtable — venue + NDA needs

Hi team,

Quick kickoff for the SF executive dinner / roundtable we're planning for the week of March 15. High level: 2.5 hour evening (dinner + 60-min roundtable), ~20 invitees (mix of customer execs + a couple of strategic partners). Objectives: 1) deepen exec relationships at Ellison & Blue Harbor, 2) surface adoption blockers for CatalystAI use cases, and 3) introduce Redwood Dedicated for regulated customers.

Please review the attached invite_list_master.xlsx and initial_budget.xlsx. Action items below — please flag blockers by EOD Friday (Feb 27):
- Confirm VIP guest list (we need final names for NDAs for Ellison & Blue Harbor by next Tue).
- Confirm venue options: I spoke to The Marin Club and they can host; contract draft incoming.
- NDA: two customers asked for mutual NDA before sharing sensitive product roadmap details. I attached our event NDA template (we plan to use redwood_event_nda_v1.pdf). Can Legal sign/advise? If any internal/partner signatory changes required, note them.
- Catering & dietary: propose plated 3-course (will confirm pricing with CateringCo). Any vegetarian/other restrictions on the VIP list?
- Host remarks: Aditya, can you draft 5–7 min exec remarks and a 2-slide product highlight for the roundtable?

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-event-assets (assets + slides + invites).

Attachments referenced: invite_list_master.xlsx, initial_budget.xlsx, redwood_event_nda_v1.pdf

Thanks — V

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Field Events | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Thanks Vanessa — this looks great. A couple quick Qs: 
1) RSVP target: are we aiming for 12–15 confirmed attendees to ensure a focused conversation or do we want to over-invite to 20 with expected 60–70% show? My recommendation: over-invite to 20 (aim 14–15 show).
2) Budget: line item for travel stipends for two remote execs? (Ellison has one exec who may fly in). If so, add to initial_budget.xlsx.
3) Food restrictions: I can start collecting dietary prefs once we have a final invite list.

On the NDA: can Legal (cc'd?) review the redwood_event_nda_v1.pdf? If we need countersign, I'd like to consolidate NDAs into a single DocuSign envelope.

On Mar 23 note: I recommend The Marin Club as a top option based on ambience and private dining rooms — they gave a venue hold through March 10.
